# opnsense_interfaces_assignment (Data Source)

Retrieves an assigned OPNsense interface. This data source exposes the assignment, description, and lock only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_interfaces_assignment" "lan" {
  id = "opt1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) OPNsense interface identifier, such as `opt1`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Short description used to identify the interface.
- `device` (String) Assigned physical or virtual network device.
- `lock` (Boolean) Whether the interface is protected from removal.
